_about: Closed list of own-committee transfer pairs. Each pair is a receiving candidate committee, by its State Board of Elections committee id, and a giving donor that is another political committee of the same person. The key is recipient_sbe_committee_id plus donor_id; the other fields describe the pair and are not validated. An addition or removal is a new ruling: see campaign-finance/RULINGS.md, the entry on transfers from a candidate's other committee.
